title: A 50 MPH Storm STALLED Their Final Push #shorts
description:
Mom's send-off, one final sprint - then 50-mile-an-hour gusts blind them mid-run.
Visibility dies and they hunker down. Behind them, Thea is pushing the bag at 72%.
#Shorts #Sandstorm #FinishLine #SurvivalRace
